Pull requests are not accepted on this repository.

Tideline is generated from its source at tailthemes.com, so a merge here is overwritten by the next release and your work is lost. That is the only reason.

Open an issue describing the change instead. It gets fixed at the source and ships in the next version, to everyone. Tideline's page: https://tailthemes.com/themes/tideline?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=tideline
